meta.name: baoyu-podcast-summary
meta.description: Summarizes podcasts, interviews, panels, and other conversation transcripts into an objective, reader-first summary written in the user's preferred language. Leads with the few takeaways worth keeping, retells them faithfully with clear speaker attribution, and adds no opinions of its own. Accepts a pasted transcript, a transcript file, or a YouTube URL (transcript fetched through baoyu-youtube-transcript), infers unnamed speakers from context, and uses web search to verify names and supply background. Use when the user provides a transcript or a podcast/interview link and asks to "summarize this podcast", "podcast summary", "interview summary", "key takeaways", "总结播客", "播客总结", "访谈总结", "总结一下这期播客", "总结这个访谈", or shares a YouTube interview and wants a written summary rather than the raw transcript.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。
